title: Maude What's New feed
description: User-facing product-update entries surfaced in the Maude UI (and mirrored to the docs site). Single source of truth — ships with the dev-server, appended on /flow:done, stamped at release. See .ai/plans/feature-in-app-whats-new-tour.md (DDR-A).

id.description: Stable slug (usually the plan slug). Used for de-dup and as the React key.

version.description: Semver the feature shipped in, or null while pending (stamped at release).

date.description: Release date YYYY-MM-DD, or null while pending.

learnMore.description: Optional URL to docs / release notes. Constrained to http(s) — the feed renders this as an <a href>, so a javascript:/data: scheme is rejected at the data-contract layer (defense-in-depth alongside React's URL sanitizer).

surface.description: Which UI surface this targets (e.g. design-ui). Future-proofing.

tour.description: Optional spotlight steps that highlight the new UI (consumed by the tour engine — Phase 3).

replayable.description: false = the tour spotlights chrome that no longer exists (the v1 menubar, the CSS panel, ...), so the panel does not offer 'Take tour' for this entry. The steps stay in the file as history. Absent means true. test/tour-targets.test.ts holds every replayable tour to real hooks.

target.description: CSS selector or [data-tour="<key>"] anchor to spotlight. Prefer the stable [data-tour] anchors over styling classes (which churn on redesigns).

canvas.description: Setup: ensure a canvas is open before the step (the tour opens the first one if none).

inspector.description: Setup: open the right-hand Inspector panel before the step.

tab.description: Setup: switch the Inspector to this tab before the step.

optional.description: Skip this step when its target is absent (a role or shell state without that element) instead of showing it centred. Never set on a single-step tour.

requireSelection.description: The target only exists once an element is ⌘-clicked in the (cross-origin) canvas. The card shows a '⌘-click to continue' hint and the spotlight snaps onto the real row when a selection lands.
